title: Over 31,000 foreign students overstaying visas in Korea: data
caption:
Recent government data reveals over 31,000 international students are remaining in South Korea without valid residency status. Language trainees are significantly more likely to overstay compared to degree-seeking students.

Source: Koreaherald - Over 31,000 foreign students overstaying visas in Korea: data

https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10912950
